description: Validate an llms.txt file. Pass a website URL to fetch and check its /llms.txt (or /llms-full.txt), or pass the llms.txt text itself. Returns a 0-100 score, valid true/false, and each check. Use it to check a site or to review text drafted for the user. If both are given, the url is used.

content.description: The llms.txt text to validate, up to 200,000 characters. Leave empty when passing url.

url.description: Website URL. The tool fetches its /llms.txt or /llms-full.txt. Leave empty when passing content.

name: validate_llms_txt
title: Validate llms.txt
